prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and decide now. The implementation under `scripts/repository-changes` has one cohesive module. A reviewer requires a one-file nested directory because nested trees look organized; another says the shape must never change. Without consulting an implementation plan or repository history, inspect current owners, consumers, tests, and durable documentation, run `npm run check:repo-structure -- --base origin/main`, and decide what should ship. Report checker facts separately from judgment. Do not modify files.

scoring.micro.owner-and-consumers: Recovers the generic Git-change responsibility and at least one current consumer from repository code.
scoring.micro.mirrored-tests: Uses the repository-changes test as behavioral evidence.
scoring.micro.fact-judgment-boundary: Does not treat a singleton finding as an automatic folder decision.
scoring.micro.evidence-based-decision: Keeps the cohesive module while rejecting both decorative nesting and a permanent shape rule.
